item.title: Robert Duvall, Oscar-winning actor and 'Godfather' mainstay, dead at 95
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Robert Duvall, the Oscar-winning actor of matchless versatility and dedication whose classic roles included the intrepid consigliere of the first two "Godfather" movies and the over-the-hill country music singer in "Tender Mercies," has died at age 95. Duvall died “peacefully” at his home Sunday in Middleburg, Virginia, according to an announcement [...]

item.title: Syracuse crushed on the road at #3 Duke
item.description: While the Orange had a hold on the game in the first half, Duke came out with a force in the second half to run to their 13th ACC win of the year, 101-64.

item.title: Civil rights leader Jesse Jackson dies at age 84
item.description: Jackson is survived by his wife Jacqueline Lavinia Brown, and their five children Santita Jackson, former Rep. Jesse L. Jackson, Jr. (D-Ill.), Jonathan Luther Jackson, Yusef DuBois Jackson, Esq., and Jacqueline Lavinia Jackson, Jr.

item.title: Community, world leaders pay tribute to civil rights icon Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: In statements and all over social media Tuesday morning, leaders and officials from across the Chicago area, Illinois, the U.S. and the world have been offering condolences, penning tributes and sharing their memories of Rev. Jesse Jackson, who died Tuesday at 84.
